text: When I get married into music, I will play. Hey, boy, people playin' chicken reel all day. One night went from the party. She was walkin' home with Bill. Now he's a steady fella, and the night was dark and still. It seems he's so a chicken man. When Liza heard of that, she said, I'm gonna wear it on the coat and beaten hat. I guess they must be crazy, answered William with a smile. But Liza said, go on, you haven't heard the latest style. Went first, she wore it out the peephole.
